ex.s: Simple readings are now readily available on our phones and wearables.
ex.t: 如今，我们的手机和可穿戴设备都能轻松给出这些简单读数。

ex.s: Over the last seven years, most states have banned texting by drivers, and public service campaigns have tried a wide range of methods to persuade people to put down their phones when they are behind the wheel.
ex.t: 过去七年里，大多数州已禁止司机发短信，公益宣传用了多种方法说服人们开车时放下手机。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.t: 如今，在澳大利亚，很难找到15岁以上没有手机的人。

ex.s: In rural areas, where ambulances can take a relatively long time to arrive, the phone boxes have taken on a lifesaving role.
ex.t: 在农村地区，救护车可能需要相对较长的时间才能到达，电话亭因此发挥了挽救生命的作用。

ex.s: A lot of business is still done over the phone，and much of it is based on trust and existing relationships.
ex.t: 很多生意仍然通过电话完成，而且其中很大一部分是基于信任和现有关系。

ex.s: Mum was using Dad's phone to take photos of the colourful little houses along the coast when we saw something amazing - a killer whale!

ex.s: About that time, Tony Inglis’ engineering and transport company got the job to remove phone boxes from the streets and sell them out.

ex.s: LoveFone, a company that advocates repairing cellphones rather than abandoning them, opened a mini workshop in a London phone box in 2016.
ex.t: 倡导修理而非丢弃手机的LoveFone公司，于2016年在伦敦一个电话亭里开了一家迷你工坊。

ex.s: I mean to make an actual phone call — not to shelter from the rain.
ex.t: 我指的是打一通真正的电话——而不是躲雨。

ex.s: That said, to be honest the only people who ever ring our home phone are our Baby Boomers parents, to the point where we play a game and guess who is calling before we pick up the phone （using Caller ID would take the fun out of it）.
ex.t: 也就是说，老实说，唯一会给我们家座机打电话的人是我们婴儿潮一代的父母，以至于我们会玩个游戏，在接电话前猜是谁打来的（用来电显示会破坏这种乐趣）。

ex.t: 两小时后，回到家中，我听到敲门声。我丈夫（4）_____应了门，当时我在餐厅打电话。“詹妮弗住这儿吗？”我听到一位女士说。我丈夫手里是我的钱包，一分钱（5）_____都没少。我还没来得及（6）_____走到门口道谢，她就走了。

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 在成为许多英国街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭从20世纪80年代开始逐渐消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数被送进了垃圾场。

ex.t: 当地组织可以用1英镑的价格认领它们，并安装除颤仪以备紧急情况使用。
